page.title: AI Pronunciation Trainer
page.description: Practise English pronunciation with instant AI feedback on every word.
page.noscript: This page needs JavaScript to record and score your reading.
header.tagline: English · instant feedback on every word
lang.label: Language
level.label: Level
card.loadFailedHelp: Check the internet connection, then try again.
controls.wait: A sentence is loading. Wait a moment.
notice.offline.title: You’re offline
notice.offline.text: New sentences, listening and scores need the internet.
notice.cantRecord.title: This browser can’t record audio
notice.cantRecord.text: Open this page in Chrome or Safari to practise speaking.
notice.insecure.title: Recording needs a secure connection
notice.insecure.text: Open the page from its https:// address to practise speaking.
notice.linkCopied.title: Link copied
notice.linkCopied.text: Open Chrome (or Safari), tap the address bar and paste.
notice.copyBlocked.title: Copy the link yourself
notice.copyBlocked.text: Press and hold the address below, then tap Copy.
notice.noVoice.title: The sample voice isn’t available
notice.noVoice.text: The sentence can’t be read aloud right now. You can still record and get a score.
notice.loadFailed.title: Couldn’t load a new sentence
notice.loadFailed.text: Check the internet connection, then try again.
mytext.title: Practise my own text
mytext.label: Type or paste English text
mytext.placeholder: e.g. Could you tell me the way to the station, please?
mytext.longWarning: This may take longer than 30 seconds to read, and recording stops at 30 s. Try a shorter text.
mytext.tooLong: Too long ({chars}, {words}): keep it under {maxChars} characters and {maxWords} words.
mytext.empty: Please type at least one English word.
mytext.failed: Couldn’t prepare this text. Check the internet connection, then try again.
rec.allow: Allow the microphone if your browser asks.
rec.hintWide: Read the sentence, then click {stop} or press {space}.
rec.cantHear: We can’t hear you. Speak louder or move closer to the microphone.
rec.checkingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
rec.stillChecking: Still checking. It can take longer when many people practise at the same time.
rec.busyWait: The server is busy. Sending again in {seconds} s…
rec.busyHint: Many people are practising right now. Your recording is kept.
rec.busyAnnounce: The server is busy. Your recording will be sent again by itself.
rec.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it from the icon in the address bar, then try again.
rec.micMissing: No microphone was found. Connect one, then try again.
rec.tooShort: That was too short. Read the whole sentence before you tap Stop.
rec.silent: We couldn’t hear anything. Check that the right microphone is chosen and not muted.
result.meaning: The computer heard {percent}% of the sentence as written.
how.title: How it works
how.step1: Listen to the sentence. Turn on {slow} if it is too fast.
how.step2: Tap the {mic}, read the sentence aloud, then tap {stop}.
how.step3: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice. Tap a word to compare.
how.step1Wide: Listen to the sentence (Slow if you need it).
how.step2Wide: Click the microphone or press {space}, read aloud, then Stop.
how.step3Wide: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice: click one to compare.

error.text_too_long: This text is too long. Keep it under 300 characters and 60 words.
error.text_not_english: Please type English text with A–Z letters.
error.text_bad_characters: This text has hidden characters that cannot be read. Type it again, or paste it as plain text.
error.invalid_request: The server couldn’t use this request. Please try again.
error.bad_category: This level isn’t available. Choose another one.
error.bad_language: This language isn’t available on this server.
error.no_audio: No recording reached the server. Please try again.
error.bad_audio: The recording couldn’t be read. Please try again.
error.audio_too_long: That recording is too long. Keep it under 30 seconds.
error.request_entity_too_large: That recording is too large to send. Keep it under 30 seconds.
error.no_speech: We couldn’t hear any words. Check that the microphone is not muted, then read the sentence aloud.
error.busy: The server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
error.tts_busy: The sample voice is busy. Please try again in a moment.
error.tts_unavailable: This server has no sample voice.
error.tts_failed: The sample voice couldn’t read this text.
error.scoring_failed: Couldn’t check your recording. Please try again.
error.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
error.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Please try again.
error.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the internet connection, then try again.
error.offline: You’re offline. Connect to the internet, then try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
